CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END;
$function$
functions.name: set_updated_at

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_task_asset_links()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO task_asset_links(task_id, asset_id, source, source_summary)
    SELECT task.id, NEW.id, 'system', U&'\4efb\52a1\6267\884c\671f\95f4\81ea\52a8\5173\8054'
    FROM unnest(NEW.task_ids) AS requested(task_id)
    JOIN tasks task ON task.id=requested.task_id AND task.deleted_at IS NULL
    ON CONFLICT (task_id, asset_id) DO NOTHING;

    DELETE FROM task_asset_links link
    WHERE link.asset_id=NEW.id
      AND NOT (link.task_id=ANY(NEW.task_ids));
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: sync_task_asset_links

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.try_inet(value text)
 RETURNS inet
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN value::inet;
EXCEPTION WHEN others THEN
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
functions.name: try_inet
